//: Where the book manuscripts live on this machine.
The books are not open source, so their paths are not committed. Copy this file
to manuscripts.json (gitignored) and set the roots, or point AIFIRST_MANUSCRIPTS
at a copy kept outside the checkout.
Each root is the folder holding that book's chapter .docx files. Omit a book you
do not have a copy of: the scraper will just skip it.
Only `bun run scrape` reads this. Nothing else in the repo needs it, and CI never
